analogy.rationale: SSREs modulate serotonergic signaling, but these cell lines express little neuronal serotonin machinery, so transcriptional response should be weak; SSRIs share the closest monoaminergic mechanism, while serotonin and opioid receptor ligands are annotated targets but also largely inactive in these cells.
